designRecord.quote: Planning brief for a new test, not collected results: investigate ink formula while controlling room temperature. There are 32 fresh cards; one card is an experimental unit and can receive either ink. Retain the same card stock, stamped area and ink volume. The outcome is drying time in seconds. Measurement rule: start timing at stamping, then press a fresh clean test strip lightly at five-second intervals until no ink transfers; record that elapsed time for each card. The available temperature settings are 18 °C and 26 °C.
